purpose: Bound the run-to-run spread of the frame cadence counters on one unchanged image before attributing any difference to a command-line or driver change.
result: The same image, same command line and same instruction produced a mean interval of 26.51 ms and then 36.13 ms. Swap arrival moved by 11.86 ms and the GPU fence wait by 3.61 ms with no software change.
consequence: The spread of a single run is larger than every single-variable difference measured so far on this board. The tu-default-a result at 34.16 ms lies inside this spread, so removing tu-debug=noubwc,nocb cannot be credited or blamed for it. Every further comparison needs alternating runs of both configurations in one session, or a median of several runs, taken with the tablet in the same state.
open_question: What makes one run 26 ms and another 36 ms is unknown. Candidates are thermal state, CPU frequency, the low DRAM envelope and background work; the counters cannot separate them yet.
